snippet.title: Shadow of The Colossus - E3 2005 Trailer [High Quality]
snippet.description:
High quality trailer of the game Shadow of The Colossus, developed by Team Ico and released in 2005 for Playstation 2.

Source: Official E3 2005 Playstation press disc
